rules.reason: The course suite (17 files, 716 tests) needs 50 to 260 s of wall time on a quiet host and five times that at load 40 to 70; three shards keep each far inside its budget (Vitest assigns 6, 6 and 5 files).

shardNotHonoured.en: No command of ${label} honoured shard ${index}/${total}; this shard ran the whole task.
shardNotHonoured.de: Kein Befehl von ${label} hat den Shard ${index}/${total} beachtet; dieser Shard hat die ganze Aufgabe ausgeführt.
